title: 聊聊你的工作与强项
category: 工作 · 团队合作与面试
level: B1 起步 · 看完再校准
summary: 5 分钟美音：跟 Anna 和 Pete 聊工作、合作与面试。先看视频，选简单／适合／困难，再和外教聊自己的项目。
goals: 先看一遍 5 分钟视频，记录难易和卡点，不做开课考试
学会介绍自己的强项、合作方式，以及最自豪的一项工作
把视频表达用到技术面试和团队讨论，再按反馈调整下一课

source.title: Let’s Learn English — Level 2, Lesson 2: The Interview
source.licenseSummary: 来源：VOA Learning English。VOA 独立制作的文字、音频与视频按官网声明属于公有领域；第三方素材除外。本站使用该原创教学课的官网对话，注明来源；中文释义、例句和练习为本站原创。视频由官方服务器提供，不镜像第三方素材。
source.captions: 画面内置英文字幕（不可关闭）；本次自评请选英文字幕。
source.notes: 已获取官方视频并核实媒体时长 300.36 秒、画面英文字幕及官方课程 PDF 的对话内容。课程为 VOA 美式英语教学材料，语速较清楚，实际难度由你的自评和对话校准。YouTube 仍返回 403，未核实对应视频 ID，先使用官方播放器。
source.textNote: 以下为 VOA 官网完整对话（含 Professor Bot 讲解），中文为本站释义；官网个别文字与实际口播可能有差异，以音频为准。原网页 “I want you team up” 缺少 to，正文保留原文；正确句型见词汇与句型页。

text.speaker: Anna
text.en: Ms. Weaver is giving new assignments out. I am ready to take on anything she gives me. Well, except reporting traffic from a helicopter. Wish me luck.
text.zh: Weaver 女士正在分配新任务。她交给我什么，我都准备接下来。当然，从直升机上报道路况除外。祝我好运。

text.speaker: Professor Bot
text.en: I wonder what Anna’s new assignment will be? Professor Bot here! While you are watching, look for phrasal, or two-word verbs. Some stay together, like “go back” and some can come apart, like “give [assignments] out.” Good luck, Anna!
text.zh: 我想知道 Anna 的新任务会是什么。我是 Bot 教授！观看时请找找短语动词，也叫双词动词。有些要放在一起，比如 go back；有些可以拆开，比如 give [assignments] out。祝你好运，Anna！

text.speaker: Ms. Weaver
text.en: So, as I said at the meeting last week, I have new assignments for everyone at The Studio. Anna, you're good at asking questions. So, I want you to go back to hosting and reporting.
text.zh: 正如我上周开会时所说，我给演播室的每个人都安排了新任务。Anna，你很擅长提问，所以我想让你回去做主持和报道。

text.speaker: Anna
text.en: That sounds great.
text.zh: 听起来很不错。

text.speaker: Ms. Weaver
text.en: You're also a team player. So, I want you team up with someone ...
text.zh: 你也很有团队精神，所以我想让你和某个人搭档……

text.speaker: Anna
text.en: That sounds even better!
text.zh: 听起来更好了！

text.speaker: Ms. Weaver
text.en: ... someone who is very "different" from you.
text.zh: ……一个与你很“不一样”的人。

text.speaker: Anna
text.en: That sounds ... what do you mean "different"?
text.zh: 听起来……你说“不一样”是什么意思？

text.speaker: Ms. Weaver
text.en: Well, you are very cheerful, you're a people person. I want you to team up with someone who ... isn't.
text.zh: 你很开朗，很善于与人打交道。我想让你和一个不太这样的人合作。

text.speaker: Anna
text.en: Ms. Weaver, I will find that person.
text.zh: Weaver 女士，我会找到那个人的。

text.speaker: Mimi
text.en: Excuse me. Are you using this chair?
text.zh: 打扰一下，这把椅子你在用吗？

text.speaker: Pete
text.en: Yes.
text.zh: 是的。

text.speaker: Anna
text.en: Pete, hi! Thanks for meeting me.
text.zh: 嗨，Pete！谢谢你来见我。

text.speaker: Pete
text.en: Sure. But I don’t have lots of time, Anna. I’m busy looking for work.
text.zh: 当然。不过我时间不多，Anna。我正忙着找工作。

text.speaker: Anna
text.en: Pete, you can tear these want ads up and throw them away! I have good news!
text.zh: Pete，你可以把这些招聘广告撕掉、扔掉了！我有好消息！

text.speaker: Pete
text.en: Anna, I was working on that crossword puzzle.
text.zh: Anna，我刚才在做上面的填字游戏。

text.speaker: Anna
text.en: Oh. Sorry. Sorry. Pete, forget about the crossword puzzle. I have a job offer for you!
text.zh: 哦，对不起，对不起。Pete，先别管填字游戏了。我有个工作机会给你！

text.speaker: Pete
text.en: I'm listening.
text.zh: 你说，我听着。

text.speaker: Anna
text.en: My boss wants me to team up with someone to host a talk show. But the person must be different from me. So, I thought of you.
text.zh: 我老板想让我和一个人搭档主持脱口秀。不过，那个人必须和我不一样。所以我想到了你。

text.speaker: Pete
text.en: Different from you? What do you mean?
text.zh: 和你不一样？什么意思？

text.speaker: Anna
text.en: I'm sorry, Pete, I don't have time right now. Here's my boss's address. Your interview is tomorrow morning at 10 am.
text.zh: 对不起，Pete，我现在没时间解释。这是我老板的地址。你明天上午十点面试。

text.speaker: Pete
text.en: But what do you mean “different”?
text.zh: 可是，你说“不一样”是什么意思？

text.speaker: Anna
text.en: Just be yourself, Pete. Just be yourself.
text.zh: 做你自己就好，Pete。做你自己。

text.speaker: Professor Bot
text.en: Did you find any two-word verbs? Here’s one example. Pete can throw the want ads away! Throw away is a two-word verb.
text.zh: 你找到了双词动词吗？这里有个例子：Pete 可以把招聘广告扔掉。throw away 是一个双词动词。

text.speaker: Ms. Weaver
text.en: Thanks for coming in, Pete.
text.zh: 谢谢你过来，Pete。

text.speaker: Pete
text.en: Thanks for the opportunity, Ms. Weaver.
text.zh: 谢谢您给我这个机会，Weaver 女士。

text.speaker: Ms. Weaver
text.en: I need to find out if you have the skills for this job. And I want you to be completely honest.
text.zh: 我需要了解你是否具备这份工作所需的技能。我希望你完全坦诚。

text.speaker: Pete
text.en: Okay.
text.zh: 好的。

text.speaker: Ms. Weaver
text.en: First, let's talk about your personal skills. Pete, are you a people person?
text.zh: 首先，我们来聊聊你的个人能力。Pete，你善于与人打交道吗？

text.speaker: Pete
text.en: Well, okay, sometimes I think people talk too much.
text.zh: 嗯，好吧，有时我觉得人们话太多了。

text.speaker: Ms. Weaver
text.en: Pete, what work of yours are you most proud of?
text.zh: Pete，你做过的工作中，最令你自豪的是哪一项？

text.speaker: Pete
text.en: Last year, I locked myself in a cabin and wrote a book. I didn't speak to anybody the entire time! It was the best two months of my life.
text.zh: 去年，我把自己关在小木屋里写了一本书。整个期间我没和任何人说话！那是我人生中最美好的两个月。

text.speaker: Ms. Weaver
text.en: Okay. I think I’ve heard enough.
text.zh: 好的，我想我已经了解得够多了。

text.speaker: Anna
text.en: Hey! Hey, Pete, how was the interview with Ms. Weaver?
text.zh: 嘿，Pete！你和 Weaver 女士的面试怎么样？

text.speaker: Pete
text.en: Well, she said I was grumpy and not good with people.
text.zh: 她说我脾气不太好，而且不擅长和人打交道。

text.speaker: Anna
text.en: And … ?
text.zh: 然后呢？

text.speaker: Pete
text.en: And, I got the job!
text.zh: 然后，我得到这份工作了！

text.speaker: Anna
text.en: I knew it! Congratulations! Let's go celebrate.
text.zh: 我就知道！恭喜你！我们去庆祝吧。

text.speaker: Pete
text.en: Okay!
text.zh: 好啊！

text.speaker: Professor Bot
text.en:
Did you find more two-word verbs? Here is the list.

give out · find out · take on · tear up · go back · throw away · team up · come in
text.zh:
你找到更多双词动词了吗？这里是清单。

清单：分发、查明、承担、撕碎、回去、扔掉、组队、进来。

vocabulary.example: I’m ready to take on the API migration.
vocabulary.note: 视频原词；工作里常接 a task / responsibility。例句为本站原创。

vocabulary.example: I teamed up with a designer to improve the checkout flow.
vocabulary.note: 视频原词；team up with someone，后接 to do 说明目标。

vocabulary.example: We need to find out why the deployment failed.
vocabulary.note: 视频原词；可接 if / why / what 从句。

vocabulary.example: My next assignment is to improve our monitoring.
vocabulary.note: 视频原词；重音在第二音节。

vocabulary.example: Thanks for the opportunity to discuss my project.
vocabulary.note: 视频原词；主重音在 TU；先清楚，再练自然弱读。

vocabulary.example: I’m proud of reducing our API response time.
vocabulary.note: 视频原表达；of 后接名词或动名词 reducing。

vocabulary.example: I’m a team player: I share context and ask for feedback.
vocabulary.note: 视频原词；面试时配具体行为，不只给自己贴标签。

vocabulary.example: She’s a people person who makes new teammates feel welcome.
vocabulary.note: 视频原词；偏日常表达。Pete 的回答是喜剧情节，不是面试示范答案。

patterns.form: be good at + 名词 / doing
patterns.explanation: at 是介词，后接动词时用 -ing。视频里是 good at asking questions。
patterns.example: I’m good at breaking complex requirements into smaller tasks.
patterns.contrast: 避免：I’m good at to solve problems。

patterns.explanation: 表达希望某人做某事。视频官网有一句漏写 to，练习时使用完整结构。
patterns.example: My manager wants me to team up with the platform team.

patterns.form: find out + if / why / what 从句
patterns.explanation: if 表示“是否”；间接疑问使用陈述语序，便于澄清需求或排查问题。
patterns.example: We need to find out if the client needs real-time updates.
patterns.contrast: 避免：find out why did the service fail。

patterns.form: be proud of + 名词 / doing
patterns.explanation: 回答项目经历时先说成果，再解释你的行动和影响。
patterns.example: I’m proud of improving our release process. I added automated checks, so we caught errors earlier.

patterns.form: 可拆分短语动词 + 代词
patterns.explanation: throw away / give out 可以拆分。代词宾语放中间：throw them away；不能把所有短语动词都按这个规则拆开。
patterns.example: These notes are useful. Please don’t throw them away.
patterns.contrast: 避免：throw away them；team up with 则保持搭配。

pronunciationTargets: opportunity / assignment：检查主重音，避免每个音节用同样力度。
team up / find out：先保留词尾辅音，再练辅音到元音的自然衔接。
proud /praʊd/ 与 people /ˈpipəl/：观察元音和词尾，是否需要纠正取决于实际录音。
I’m GOOD at asking QUESTIONS：按信息重点划分意群；再把 asking questions 换成自己的强项。
memorize: I am ready to take on anything she gives me.
Thanks for the opportunity, Ms. Weaver.
I need to find out if you have the skills for this job.
Pete, what work of yours are you most proud of?
practiceScenarios: 技术面试：用 60—90 秒介绍一个你最自豪的项目，外教追问你的具体贡献和结果。
团队合作：你要与设计师和平台工程师搭档，说明你擅长什么、愿意承担什么，并问清任务。
需求讨论：产品经理要实时通知，你用 find out if / why 澄清需求，然后复述共识。
工作安排：当前任务已满，讨论能接下什么、需要谁协作，不直接承诺一切。
生活迁移：和朋友分工准备一次旅行，说明你擅长安排什么、愿意负责什么。
assessmentFocus: 先询问难易、英文字幕与倍速条件，请学习者用自己的话解释 Anna 为什么找 Pete、面试结果为何有反差。再自然迁移到自己的技术项目和团队协作，每次只问一个问题。先观察独立回答，卡住后再给提示，区分提示前后表现。Pete 的喜剧回答不作为职业面试范例。不设固定过关分数；下一课初期仍以约 5 分钟为目标，每次只调整一个难度因素。

quiz.question: 为什么 Anna 认为 Pete 适合做搭档？
options: 他和 Anna 性格不同，符合老板的要求。
quiz.explanation: 老板希望 Anna 与性格不同的人搭档；不是在找她的复制品。

quiz.question: 技术面试被问到最自豪的工作，哪个回答最有帮助？
options: I improved our release process by adding automated checks, which caught errors earlier.
quiz.explanation: 具体行动和结果比空泛评价更有说服力；这是原创迁移题。

quiz.question: I’m good ___ asking questions.
quiz.explanation: be good at + doing，表示擅长做某事。

quiz.question: My boss wants me ___ team up with someone.
quiz.explanation: want someone to do something；官网个别句子漏写 to，练习使用完整结构。

quiz.question: We need to find ___ if the client needs real-time updates.
选择正确的短语动词语序。
quiz.explanation: 代词宾语 them 放在可拆分动词 throw 和 away 中间。
